metadata.title: Digital Supervision and Enforcement Platform Product Streams
metadata.description: Outcome flows linking customer jobs to accountable capabilities and external handoffs.
metadata.flowModelNote: Each step has concrete facts, friction and brick dependencies; all flows are proposed architecture.

streams.name: Resolve a Resident Report with a Clear Outcome
streams.description: A resident concern reaches an accountable role and an understandable outcome. Proposed delivery flow, not an assertion of Twyns internal design.

flows.title: Resolve a Resident Report with a Clear Outcome
flows.description: A resident concern reaches an accountable role and an understandable outcome.

steps.title: Capture the concern
keyFacts: Authority or assisted channels preserve relevant facts and a reference.
painPoints: Repeated submissions can create parallel unowned cases.

dependencies.name: Resident Report Intake
dependencies.description: Accept reports from authority channels, minimize contact details, detect repeated submissions and preserve a public reference. A service report does not automatically become an investigation.
dependencies.how: Supports this step through resident report intake.

dependencies.name: Authority Communications and Resident Feedback
dependencies.description: Produce understandable, purpose-limited messages for authority channels, monitor delivery and support assisted contacts. Never expose investigative details in ordinary report-status messages.
dependencies.how: Supports this step through authority communications and resident feedback.

steps.title: Triage and assign
keyFacts: Distinguish service requests from investigative purposes and assign responsibility.
painPoints: A referral without receiving ownership loses the resident concern.

dependencies.name: Case Lifecycle and Responsibility
dependencies.description: Maintain case identity, purpose, responsible authority, current role and route-specific state transitions. Preserve explicit links between separate service, fiscal and investigative records.
dependencies.how: Supports this step through case lifecycle and responsibility.

dependencies.name: Briefing and Task Assignment
dependencies.description: Turn policy priorities and reports into role-appropriate assignments with current briefing, acknowledgement and escalation when work lacks an owner.
dependencies.how: Supports this step through briefing and task assignment.

dependencies.name: Purpose, Disclosure and Retention Controls
dependencies.description: Evaluate approved purpose, regime and recipient scope; schedule lifecycle actions and holds. The authority approves policies and remains responsible for its processing obligations.
dependencies.how: Supports this step through purpose, disclosure and retention controls.

steps.title: Observe or refer
keyFacts: Authorized staff record facts or transfer work to the appropriate service.
painPoints: Incomplete context causes repeat dispatch and field repairs.

dependencies.name: Mobile Observation and Submission
dependencies.description: Capture structured observations on managed devices, show confirmed submission and recover interrupted capture. Encrypted pending submissions are a proposed requirement requiring device testing.
dependencies.how: Supports this step through mobile observation and submission.

dependencies.name: Evidence and Document Provenance
dependencies.description: Keep original evidence and permitted redacted derivatives distinct; associate capture context, integrity checks, access policy and holds with the case.
dependencies.how: Supports this step through evidence and document provenance.

dependencies.name: Case Lifecycle and Responsibility
dependencies.description: Maintain case identity, purpose, responsible authority, current role and route-specific state transitions. Preserve explicit links between separate service, fiscal and investigative records.
dependencies.how: Supports this step through case lifecycle and responsibility.

steps.title: Explain and learn
keyFacts: Send a permitted outcome and evaluate recurrence and service coverage.
painPoints: Internal closure codes do not necessarily explain outcomes to residents.

dependencies.name: Authority Communications and Resident Feedback
dependencies.description: Produce understandable, purpose-limited messages for authority channels, monitor delivery and support assisted contacts. Never expose investigative details in ordinary report-status messages.
dependencies.how: Supports this step through authority communications and resident feedback.

dependencies.name: Public-Service Outcome Analytics
dependencies.description: Build governed aggregates with denominators, quality checks, coverage and recurrence measures. Use comparative outcomes with caveats; do not infer policy causality from sanction counts.
dependencies.how: Supports this step through public-service outcome analytics.

keyFacts: Officer remit and current instructions determine appropriate action.

steps.title: Choose the correct route
keyFacts: Advice, warning, administrative action and investigative referral remain explicit choices.
painPoints: One generic sanction workflow conceals authority differences.

dependencies.name: Administrative Intervention and Decision
dependencies.description: Support warnings, inspections, corrective measures and administrative decisions with reviewed templates, effective rules and explicit approval. Deadlines and powers require authority configuration.

dependencies.name: Criminal Enforcement Dossier and Referral
dependencies.description: Prepare a remit-appropriate investigative dossier and controlled referral. The responsible officer and receiving authority retain decision powers; fiscal assessments are a separate route.
dependencies.how: Supports this step through criminal enforcement dossier and referral.

steps.title: Confirm handoff or recover
keyFacts: Verify receipt and repair a rejected or interrupted record.
painPoints: A locally saved record may never reach the next role.

rootGroups.name: Parking and Decisions
rootGroups.description: Durable outcomes for parking and decisions.

streams.name: Establish Parking Compliance without Avoidable Errors
streams.description: Reliable observations and time-relevant rights support a reviewed parking outcome. Proposed delivery flow, not an assertion of Twyns internal design.

flows.title: Establish Parking Compliance without Avoidable Errors
flows.description: Reliable observations and time-relevant rights support a reviewed parking outcome.

steps.title: Set policy and capture observations
keyFacts: Zone and time determine the applicable regime; device reads have quality limits.
painPoints: Ambiguous geometry or duplicate scans contaminate the queue.

dependencies.name: Parking Zones and Effective Regimes
dependencies.description: Version zone geometry, applicable regimes, tolerances and effective dates approved by the authority. Ambiguous locations require review.
dependencies.how: Supports this step through parking zones and effective regimes.

dependencies.name: Effective Rules and Procedure Catalog
dependencies.description: Publish authority-reviewed procedure and fact-code packs with effective intervals. Retain the exact version used for each case and make migration or rollback explicit.
dependencies.how: Supports this step through effective rules and procedure catalog.

dependencies.name: Scan Ingestion and Quality Control
dependencies.description: Accept observations from qualified scan devices, preserve capture time and provenance, deduplicate safely and quarantine low-confidence or mislocated reads.
dependencies.how: Supports this step through scan ingestion and quality control.

steps.title: Establish the rights state
keyFacts: Approved sources are checked for the observation time.
painPoints: Unavailable or stale sources cannot establish absence of payment.

dependencies.name: Time-Relevant Parking-Right Verification
dependencies.description: Check required permit and payment sources for the observation time. Distinguish confirmed rights, confirmed absence and unknown results; unknown must never be treated as non-payment.
dependencies.how: Supports this step through time-relevant parking-right verification.

dependencies.name: Partner Exchange and Reconciliation
dependencies.description: Enforce interface contracts, scoped credentials, acknowledgements, replay identifiers and failure queues across approved partners. Source outage or uncertain delivery remains an explicit business state.
dependencies.how: Supports this step through partner exchange and reconciliation.

steps.title: Review context and disposition
keyFacts: Authorized staff review flagged cases and record a justified outcome.
painPoints: Throughput incentives can swamp review capacity or miss valid exemptions.

dependencies.name: Parking Desk Review
dependencies.description: Present observations, context and rights results to authorized reviewers. Record corrections, no-action outcomes and reasons; limit scan intake against available review capacity.
dependencies.how: Supports this step through parking desk review.

dependencies.name: Evidence and Document Provenance
dependencies.description: Keep original evidence and permitted redacted derivatives distinct; associate capture context, integrity checks, access policy and holds with the case.
dependencies.how: Supports this step through evidence and document provenance.

dependencies.name: Case Lifecycle and Responsibility
dependencies.description: Maintain case identity, purpose, responsible authority, current role and route-specific state transitions. Preserve explicit links between separate service, fiscal and investigative records.
dependencies.how: Supports this step through case lifecycle and responsibility.

steps.title: Authorize follow-up and reconcile
keyFacts: Confirm fiscal delivery, relevant referral or authorized removal; allow correction.
painPoints: Repeated delivery can cause duplicate assessments or conflicting custody instructions.

dependencies.name: Parking Assessment and Referral Delivery
dependencies.description: Prepare authorized fiscal assessments or the appropriate enforcement referral, preserve decision identifiers and reconcile acknowledgement and authorized correction without duplicate effects.
dependencies.how: Supports this step through parking assessment and referral delivery.

dependencies.name: Clamping and Vehicle or Bicycle Custody
dependencies.description: Coordinate authorized removal or clamping, contractor handoff, custody evidence and release. Keep physical action and any financial settlement under the responsible operator.
dependencies.how: Supports this step through clamping and vehicle or bicycle custody.

dependencies.name: Objections, Corrections and Remedy Routing
dependencies.description: Associate incoming evidence or challenges with the original decision, route them to the proper authority and reconcile authorized corrections. Criminal appeal procedures are referred appropriately, not replaced by a municipal objection workflow.
dependencies.how: Supports this step through objections, corrections and remedy routing.
